name: DRAFT-not-frozen
notes: Every decision the final runs depend on, at the pilot's current value. Decide each on the dev split, then copy this file to configs/final.json, give it a real name (e.g. final-v1) and commit it BEFORE touching the test split. scripts/run_experiment.py --final refuses a config whose name starts with DRAFT. Keys are environment variable names (config.ENV_VARS); "" means unset, so the LLM_* entries must be filled in (the provider check, scripts/provider_check.py, gives the dated model id and the structured mode). tool_fault_rate is null as in the pilot; the proposal's scenario T is about 0.1. Secrets never go here.
